BEGIN;

-- Nettoyage limité aux matières C/D corrigées par la Commande 14.1.
WITH target_chapters AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM chapters c
  JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.id = c.subject_offering_id
  JOIN levels lev ON lev.id = o.level_id
  JOIN series se ON se.id = o.series_id
  JOIN subjects s ON s.id = o.subject_id
  WHERE lev.name = 'Première'
    AND se.name IN ('C', 'D')
    AND s.name IN ('Mathématiques', 'Mathématiques (C)', 'Mathématiques (D)', 'Physique-Chimie', 'Physique-Chimie (C)', 'Physique-Chimie (D)', 'Français', 'Anglais', 'Espagnol', 'Philosophie', 'Histoire-Géographie')
)
DELETE FROM lessons WHERE chapter_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_chapters);

DELETE FROM chapters c
USING course_subject_offerings o, levels lev, series se, subjects s
WHERE c.subject_offering_id = o.id
  AND o.level_id = lev.id
  AND o.series_id = se.id
  AND o.subject_id = s.id
  AND lev.name = 'Première'
  AND se.name IN ('C', 'D')
  AND s.name IN ('Mathématiques', 'Mathématiques (C)', 'Mathématiques (D)', 'Physique-Chimie', 'Physique-Chimie (C)', 'Physique-Chimie (D)', 'Français', 'Anglais', 'Espagnol', 'Philosophie', 'Histoire-Géographie');

-- Les anciennes offres spécialisées C/D créaient des doublons de matière ; seules leurs associations C/D sont retirées.
DELETE FROM course_subject_offerings o
USING levels lev, series se, subjects s
WHERE o.level_id = lev.id
  AND o.series_id = se.id
  AND o.subject_id = s.id
  AND lev.name = 'Première'
  AND ((se.name = 'C' AND s.name IN ('Mathématiques (C)', 'Physique-Chimie (C)'))
       OR (se.name = 'D' AND s.name IN ('Mathématiques (D)', 'Physique-Chimie (D)')));

-- Réutilisation ou création des associations C/D avec les matières canoniques.
WITH wanted(series_name, subject_name, display_order) AS (
  VALUES
    ('C', 'Français', 1), ('C', 'Anglais', 2), ('C', 'Espagnol', 3), ('C', 'Mathématiques', 4), ('C', 'Philosophie', 5), ('C', 'Physique-Chimie', 6), ('C', 'Histoire-Géographie', 7),
    ('D', 'Français', 1), ('D', 'Anglais', 2), ('D', 'Espagnol', 3), ('D', 'Mathématiques', 4), ('D', 'Philosophie', 5), ('D', 'Physique-Chimie', 6), ('D', 'Histoire-Géographie', 7)
)
INSERT INTO course_subject_offerings (level_id, series_id, subject_id, is_published, display_order)
SELECT lev.id, se.id, s.id, false, wanted.display_order
FROM wanted
JOIN levels lev ON lev.name = 'Première'
JOIN series se ON se.name = wanted.series_name
JOIN subjects s ON s.name = wanted.subject_name
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM course_subject_offerings o
  WHERE o.level_id = lev.id AND o.series_id = se.id AND o.subject_id = s.id
);

WITH wanted(series_name, subject_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('C', 'Français'), ('C', 'Anglais'), ('C', 'Espagnol'), ('C', 'Mathématiques'), ('C', 'Philosophie'), ('C', 'Physique-Chimie'), ('C', 'Histoire-Géographie'),
    ('D', 'Français'), ('D', 'Anglais'), ('D', 'Espagnol'), ('D', 'Mathématiques'), ('D', 'Philosophie'), ('D', 'Physique-Chimie'), ('D', 'Histoire-Géographie')
)
UPDATE course_subject_offerings o
SET is_published = false
FROM wanted
JOIN levels lev ON lev.name = 'Première'
JOIN series se ON se.name = wanted.series_name
JOIN subjects s ON s.name = wanted.subject_name
WHERE o.level_id = lev.id AND o.series_id = se.id AND o.subject_id = s.id;

INSERT INTO lessons (chapter_id, title, content, description, display_order, is_active, is_test_data)
SELECT c.id, lesson_ref.title, '', '', lesson_ref.display_order, false, false
FROM lesson_ref
JOIN levels lev ON lev.name = 'Première'
JOIN series se ON se.name = lesson_ref.series_name
JOIN subjects s ON s.name = lesson_ref.subject_name
JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id = lev.id AND o.series_id = se.id AND o.subject_id = s.id
JOIN chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id = o.id AND c.display_order = lesson_ref.chapter_order;

COMMIT;
